newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen on the sidelines during intervention time.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen on the sidelines during intervention time.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to remain out of the banking system during its usual intervention period Friday morning, economists said.
While there was a possibility the Fed could add reserves, economists said outstanding operations would probably be sufficient to address the add need over the weekend.
Federal funds were trading at 5.15 percent, below the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/4 percent.
